knowledge_graph.title: Rice
knowledge_graph.description: Rice is a cereal grain and in its domesticated form is the staple food of over half of the world's population, particularly in Asia and Africa. Rice is the seed of the grass species Oryza sativa —or, much less commonly, Oryza glaberrima.

text_blocks.snippet: The calorie content of sambar rice can vary depending on the ingredients and recipe used. However, according to general estimates, a typical serving of sambar rice (around 200 grams) contains approximately 150-200 calories.
Here are some specific calorie estimates for different types of sambar rice:

list.snippet: Sambar rice with lentils: 180-200 calories per serving
Instant sambar rice mix: 150-170 calories per serving
Vegetarian sambar rice: 120-150 calories per serving
Sambar rice with chicken or fish: 200-250 calories per serving

text_blocks.snippet: It's important to note that these are just estimates, and the actual calorie content may be higher or lower depending on the specific ingredients and cooking method.
